description: This file is a Java class named TextureRenderer that handles OpenGL ES rendering in an Android application. It contains shader programs, buffer setup, and rendering methods to display textures on a surface, specifically for media effects or effects rendering.

classes.name: TextureRenderer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering textures using OpenGL ES in an Android environment. It manages shader programs, texture size, view size, and rendering logic.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the shader program and setup attribute and uniform handles, along with coordinate buffers.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Deletes the OpenGL program to clean up resources.

methods.name: updateTextureSize
methods.description: Updates the size of the texture and recalculates the output vertices accordingly.

methods.name: updateViewSize
methods.description: Updates the view size and recalculates the output vertices to maintain aspect ratio.

methods.name: renderTexture
methods.description: Binds the texture, sets the viewport, and renders the texture onto the surface.
